meta.name: version-bump
meta.description: Automated semantic versioning and release workflow for Claude Code plugins. Handles version increments across package.json, marketplace.json, plugin.json manifests, build verification, git tagging, GitHub releases, and changelog generation. NPM publishing (so `npx claude-mem@X.Y.Z` resolves) is handed off to the human maintainer, who raised npm security.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动管理版本号并生成发布流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每次发布前都要手动改版本号和写更新日志
copy.tagline_en: Automate version bumps and release workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manually update version numbers and changelogs before every release

howto.what: 自动执行插件发布流程:更新所有带版本号的配置文件,运行构建同步,提交并推送代码与标签,创建 GitHub Release,重写变更日志,最后提示你手动执行 npm 发布。
howto.when: 当你要发布 Claude Code 插件的新版本,或需要执行完整的版本升级与发布流程时进入。

say.text: 把版本号升到 2.0.0,跑完整套发布流程
say.note: 会自动更新版本、构建、提交、打标签并创建 Release

say.text: 发布 v1.4.2 到 GitHub,并生成变更日志
say.note: 会走发版流程并重写 CHANGELOG.md

say.text: 帮我做一次版本发布,记得最后提醒我手动 npm publish
say.note: npm 发布会留给人工执行

howto.what_en: Automates the plugin release workflow: bumps the version in all config files, runs build/sync, commits and pushes code and tags, creates a GitHub release, regenerates the changelog, then hands off npm publishing to the user.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to release a new version of a Claude Code plugin or run the full version bump and release process.

say_en.text: Bump the version to 2.0.0 and run the full release process
say_en.note: It updates versions, builds, commits, tags, and creates a release.

say_en.text: Release v1.4.2 to GitHub and regenerate the changelog
say_en.note: Runs the release flow and rewrites CHANGELOG.md.

say_en.text: Do a release and remind me to publish to npm manually
say_en.note: npm publishing is left to the human.
